title: STARTEX: 02:40, Lakechart Is Spinning

fields.location: Lakemont Community Hospital, Duluth, Minnesota (EXERCISE: all patients and record numbers are fictional)
fields.load: 98 inpatients, 22 patients in the ED, one woman in active labor on L&D
fields.staffing: Night shift; on-call analyst Ananya Desai (ext. 5503) on site; Marcus Ellery and Dr. Priya Raman driving in
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise, and all patients and record numbers are fictional. It is 02:40 on Tuesday, February 9, 2027, at Lakemont Community Hospital in Duluth. Lakechart and the interface engine both showed green (OK) at the 02:00 check, but since 02:14 the IS Help Desk has been taking calls from the ICU, med-surg and ED charge nurses: "Lakechart is just spinning, we can't open a chart or scan a med." On-call analyst Ananya Desai is now on the phone to the Administrator on Call: "Both the EHR and the interface engine have been down since 02:10. The status dashboard shows LAKECHART PROD, RED, DOWN, and INTERFACE ENGINE, RED, DOWN. I don't know the cause yet and nobody has looked at security. Marcus Ellery and Dr. Priya Raman are driving in. Nobody has declared anything yet, and Gregory Pruitt hasn't been called."

status.name: LAKECHART PROD (EHR)
status.note: RED: DOWN since 02:10. Charts will not open and med scanning is unavailable.

status.name: INTERFACE ENGINE
status.note: RED: DOWN since 02:10. No message flow.

status.name: IS Help Desk (ext. 5500)
status.note: AMBER: Calls from ICU, med-surg and ED charge nurses since 02:14. On-call analyst confirmed the outage at 02:25.

status.name: Downtime level
status.note: AMBER: None declared. No overhead page, hotline message or Downtime Alert text sent.

status.name: Security review
status.note: AMBER: Not started. Privacy and Security Officer Gregory Pruitt not yet notified.

status.name: Emergency Department
status.note: GREEN: Open with 22 patients. No diversion decision made.

fields.facilitatorNote: Read only the narration aloud. Point players to the status rows, then give the Administrator on Call the phone. Do not suggest a downtime level or a cause.
fields.scenarioTitle: Cold Storage: EHR Storage Failure & Downtime Continuity

instructorNote: This card opens the exercise and tests whether the IC brings in the Security Officer right away. Watch whether the IC and the Security Officer declare Level 4 under IS-14 section 3 (EHR down, interface engine lost, cause unknown). Also watch for four steps: announcing it by overhead page, ext. 5505 and the Downtime Alert text group; opening the Boardroom (ext. 5520); starting the 60-minute clock for units to be on procedures; and recording that a step-down to Level 3 waits until the standby engine is live and a security cause has been ruled out.
